note: Power's bar, cut. A white image takes its tint; a dark part baked into one stays dark. `cut` is a slice's insets in points (left, top, right, bottom): the slice's centre is the image less its cut, at 4 pixels a point. `pad` is how far an image reaches past its piece's box on every side. PowerEmber is drawn at one pixel a point and shown at its points' size. The stack is DESIGN, untried in Studio.

stack: PowerEmber: behind the well, tinted `ember`, its middle on the bar's
the well: the kit's ButtonFill tinted `well` at 0.6 and ButtonEdge tinted `edge` at 0.4, 13 past the bar above and 15 under it, 26 past each end
PowerBusChannel: on the bar's box, tinted `channel`
PowerBusGlow: one a light, on the light's own box (the bar's height less the rim top and foot), tinted the light's colour, under every light and outside any clip

a light: a plain clipping frame from cut to cut (upright sides, the gap left each side of a cut between two lights), holding PowerBusLight at the bar's whole size and place, with a UIGradient turned 90 degrees set to its `gradient`
a light's arriving end: PowerBusLight again in the same frame, white, with a UIGradient whose Transparency goes from 1 to 0.7 over `arrive.points` ending at the light's right side
PowerBusEdge: on the bar's box, tinted `edge`
the ticks: plain frames under the bar, in `faint`
PowerHandle: its box's middle on each cut, above everything
bar.lights: from `rim` inside the bar's left to `rim` inside its right; a cut at share s stands at rim + (width - 2 * rim) * s; an idle machine's light wears the battery's gradient

PowerBusChannel.use: the bar's bed, under everything; sliced

PowerBusGlow.use: on each light's own box, under every light, at 0.42; sliced

PowerBusLight.use: a light: the bar's whole size, shown through its segment's window, coloured by its gradient; sliced

PowerHandle.use: a handle's upright, its middle on the cut; its colours are its own

PowerChipBreaker.use: the Breaker row's chip; its colour is its own

PowerChipTraining.use: the Training row's chip; its colour is its own

PowerEmber.use: behind the bar's well, its middle on the bar's, at 0.16
